description: NaV(PO₄)₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4₂nm space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.82 Å. V is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted VO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.91 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent VO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.49-1.61 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent VO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.64 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one V atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent P atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent P atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one V, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na and one P atom.
